summary: Awaiting a statically known non-thenable still suspends and resumes asynchronously with the same value.

requirements.operand: proven primitive or non-thenable builtin value

target.notes: Wrap using PromiseResolve semantics and force the JS continuation boundary.

caveats: Task.FromResult plus ordinary C# await can continue synchronously and is observably different.

tests.name: await null returns null
tests.input: async function f(){const x=await null;console.log(x===null)} f();
